title: Exceptional trip to the Alhambra and Albaicin
text:
We had a fantastic trip with SunTravel Granada. I was traveling with my elderly and disabled mother. We did the private Alhambra and Albaicin tour and also travelled from Granada to Malaga airport with Rafa. 
Rafa is exceptionally kind, patient and helpful. He was great in organising tailored trips for us with prompt communication before we left. Our trip to Granada wouldn't have been the same without his input. I had some anxieties about traveling with my son and mum but Rafa took any stresses away and ensured that all age groups had a great time. 
I would highly recommend using SunTravel Gra
author: RahatM_13
